plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Kyland switch. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, power supply status, and interface traffic, for industrial managed Ethernet switches (enterprise PEN 26067).
name: Switch

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports the CPU utilization of the Kyland switch control plane (KYLAND-DEV-MIB cpuCurrentUtilRate), as a 0-100 percentage. Sustained high CPU usage can indicate control-plane overload, ring-protocol instability or attack traffic, and may lead to slow management response or packet processing delays.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports overall memory utilization of the Kyland switch (KYLAND-DEV-MIB devMemoryUtilRate) as a 0-100 percentage. High memory usage may indicate memory leaks, oversized forwarding tables or insufficient capacity. Some models may not implement this object.

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: This metric reports the master power-input state of the Kyland switch (KylandDevMasterPowerState), normalized to 1=normal / 2=abnormal.

metrics.name: device_psu_state_backup
metrics.description: This metric reports the operational state of the device backup power supply unit (KylandDevBackupPowerState), normalized to 1 (normal) or 2 (abnormal).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
